memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Irritable bowel syndrome.
Symptoms: intermittent abdominal pain, bloating, alternating diarrhea and constipation for 6 months; no weight loss; exam: soft abdomen, mild tenderness in left lower quadrant, no masses; vitals normal.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% predicted), FVC 3.6 L (95% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.78; baseline.
Smoking status: never smoked.
Inhaler technique: No inhaler prescribed.
Asthma control: Not applicable.
Plan: Start mebeverine 135 mg BD, ispaghula husk 5 g OD, loperamide 2 mg SOS; advise diet modification; review in 3 months.

tTG-IgA: <4 U/ml (negative <7).

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Irritable bowel syndrome, stable.
Symptoms: reduced bloating, occasional mild pain after spicy meals; bowel pattern mostly regular; exam: abdomen soft, non-tender.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (95% pred, +0.1 L from baseline), FVC 3.7 L (97% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.78.
Smoking status: never smoked.
Inhaler technique: No inhaler prescribed.
Asthma control: Not applicable.
Plan: Continue current meds; advise low-FODMAP diet; review in 3 months.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I’ve had a flare of cramping and loose stools after eating restaurant biryani last week; otherwise feeling okay.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Irritable bowel syndrome, mild exacerbation.
Symptoms: increased abdominal pain and diarrhea episodes twice weekly; bloating persists; exam: mild tenderness in suprapubic area, no distension.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.8 L (92% pred, -0.1 L from last), FVC 3.6 L (94% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.78.
Smoking status: never smoked.
Inhaler technique: No inhaler prescribed.
Asthma control: Not applicable.
Plan: Increase ispaghula husk to 10 g OD; continue mebeverine BD; loperamide PRN; review in 6 weeks.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Irritable bowel syndrome, improved.
Symptoms: abdominal pain reduced to once weekly, stool consistency normal; no urgency; exam: abdomen soft, non-tender.
Spirometry: FEV1 2.9 L (95% pred, +0.1 L from 12-01), FVC 3.7 L (97% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.78.
Smoking status: never smoked.
Inhaler technique: No inhaler prescribed.
Asthma control: Not applicable.
Plan: Continue current meds; consider tapering loperamide if symptom-free; review in 3 months.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: No abdominal pain or diarrhea for the past eight weeks; feeling well and able to eat out without worry.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Diagnosis: Irritable bowel syndrome, in remission.
Symptoms: asymptomatic; normal bowel habit; exam: abdomen benign.
Spirometry: FEV1 3.0 L (98% pred, +0.1 L from last), FVC 3.8 L (99% pred), FEV1/FVC 0.79.
Smoking status: never smoked.
Inhaler technique: No inhaler prescribed.
Asthma control: Not applicable.
Plan: Attempt to taper mebeverine to once daily; continue ispaghula husk 5 g OD; stop loperamide; review in 2 months.
